blurb: Bunker Hills Golf Club is located in Bunker Hills Regional Park in Coon Rapids, Minnesota. It offers a challenging golf course recognized as one of the top 25 public courses in the country by Golf Digest. The club also features a simulator center with 4 PGA Tour simulators and a banquet facility for events.
